title: BMW recalls 720K vehicles over fire risk; drivers urged to park outside - WJBF
text:
BMW recalls 720K vehicles over potential fire hazard; owners urged to park outside 
 WJBF 
 BMW recalls 720K vehicles over fire risk; drivers urged to park outside
 Caroline Jaime 
 2 hours ago 
 ( NewsNation ) – BMW of North America has issued a recall of more than 720,000 vehicles over an issue that poses the risk of fire — even if the cars are “parked and turned off,” according to an alert posted by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA).
 The issue concerns the vehicles’ water pumps, which may become exposed to water due to an “improperly sealed electrical connector.” The connector, if wet, can short circuit and cause a fire, according to the NHTSA alert.
 The vehicles affected by the recall were already recalled in 2024 for a water pump issue, but “must be repaired again.”

 As of Friday, the NHTSA said there had been “approximately” 10 instances of faulty components causing issues for drivers, though none had resulted in crashes or injuries. 
 The recall is said to affect a total of 720,796 vehicles of different BMW models, between the model years of 2012 through 2018. A full list of impacted vehicles is below.
 2012-2016 BMW 3 Series
 2012-2016 BMW 5 Series
 2012–2015 BMW X1
 2012-2016 BMW Z4
 2013-2017 BMW X3
 2014-2016 BMW 2 Series coupe
 2014–2016 BMW 3 Series sportswagon
 2014-2016 BMW 328xi Gran Turismo
 2014-2016 BMW 4 Series convertible
 2014-2016 BMW 4 Series coupe
 2015-2016 BMW 2 Series convertible
 2015-2016 BMW 4 Series gran coupe
 2015-2018 BMW X4
 2016-2018 BMW X5 xDrive40e
 BMW is urging anyone who drives one of the recalled vehicles to “park your vehicle outside and away from buildings and other vehicles” until they can be repaired. 
 Owners will be provided with more information concerning a fix for the issue, which will be provided at no charge by BMW. Owner notifications containing information about the recall are expected to be sent out in late December.
